// Generated by Pretzel > Data Format > Setup. It is yours to edit; regenerating asks before replacing it.
//
// Encrypted saves (@@MODE_TEXT@@). The format, folder and key source come from
// Assets/Resources/Pretzel/DataIOConfig.asset (Pretzel > Data Format), and the key is loaded at runtime from that
// key source. Both are read once, before the first scene loads, and stay fixed until the game stops: stop Play mode,
// change the settings, then play (or build) again.
//
// Key sources: Provider (the generated PretzelDataSetup, which registers before this runs) or BundledJson.
// When the key arrives later, for example from your server after sign-in, keep the key source on Provider with no
// provider registered at startup. Setup then waits until you call one of these once:
//
//     ProjectDataIO.InitializeWithKeys(keysFromYourServer);
//     ProjectDataIO.Initialize();   // after PretzelDataSetup.LoadKeysAsync succeeded
//
// Register schema migrations in a separate file, so regenerating this one keeps them:
//
//     public static partial class ProjectDataIO
//     {
//         static partial void ConfigureStore(DataStoreOptions options) => options.AddMigration<Profile>(new ProfileV1ToV2());
//     }
//
// @@USAGE@@
//
// An AES key that ships with the game can be recovered by a determined player, with or without IL2CPP. This stops
// casual editing of saves and settings, not a cheater. Keep keys that must stay secret on a server.
using System;
using System.Threading;
using Pretzel.Data;
using UnityEngine;

public static partial class ProjectDataIO
{
    // Used only when the DataIOConfig asset is missing. The asset wins when it exists.
    private const EncryptionMode FallbackMode = EncryptionMode.@@MODE@@;
    private const KeySource FallbackKeySource = KeySource.@@KEY_SOURCE@@;
    private const string FallbackSaveFolder = "SaveData";

    private static IDataStore _store;
    private static string _description;

    public static bool IsReady => _store != null;

    /// <summary>The store behind DataIO.Default, created once per run.</summary>
    public static IDataStore Store => _store ?? throw NotReady();

    /// <summary>Which key is active and where it came from. Fingerprints only, never key material.</summary>
    public static string Describe() => _description ?? "ProjectDataIO is not initialized.";

    /// <summary>Implement in another part of this class to add migrations or other store options.</summary>
    static partial void ConfigureStore(DataStoreOptions options);

    /// <summary>Completes once the store exists, including after a later InitializeWithKeys.</summary>
    public static async Awaitable<IDataStore> WhenReadyAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        while (_store == null)
        {
            await Awaitable.NextFrameAsync(cancellationToken);
        }

        return _store;
    }

    // Static state survives Play sessions when domain reload is disabled.
    [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
    private static void ResetForPlaySession()
    {
        _store = null;
        _description = null;
    }

    [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.BeforeSceneLoad)]
    private static void InitializeOnStartup() => Create(null, null, true);

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the store from the configured key source. Runs automatically before the first scene loads; call it yourself
    /// only after a deferred Provider registered its key. Calling it again does nothing.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        if (!IsReady)
        {
            Create(null, null, false);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Creates the store with keys you already hold (a token flow, a key service). Keep them in memory only.</summary>
    public static void InitializeWithKeys(EncryptionKeys keys)
    {
        if (keys == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(keys));
        }

        if (IsReady)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("ProjectDataIO is already initialized. Settings and keys stay fixed until the game stops.");
        }

        Create(keys, "keys passed to InitializeWithKeys", false);
    }

    private static void Create(EncryptionKeys given, string givenOrigin, bool startup)
    {
        DataIOConfig config = LoadConfig();
        try
        {
            if (config.format != DataFormat.Encrypted)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The DataIOConfig is not set to Encrypted, but this setup is for encrypted data. "
                    + "Choose Encrypted on the Format tab, or generate the plain or binary setup on the Setup tab.");
            }

            if (config.encryptionMode != EncryptionMode.Aes)
            {
                throw new NotSupportedException("Only AES encryption is supported.");
            }

            if (startup && config.keySource == KeySource.Provider && EncryptionKeys.Provider == null)
            {
                if (Debug.isDebugBuild)
                {
                    Debug.Log("[ProjectDataIO] No key provider is registered yet. Waiting for Initialize or InitializeWithKeys.");
                }

                return;
            }

            string origin = givenOrigin;
            EncryptionKeys keys = given ?? EncryptionKeys.Resolve(config.environmentPrefix, config.keySource, out origin);
            if (keys == null || !keys.CanWrite(config.encryptionMode))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"No {config.encryptionMode} key was found (key source: {config.keySource}). "
                    + "Export the key on the Keys tab and make the key source match it, or pass keys to InitializeWithKeys.");
            }

            // The store keeps its own copy; nothing here holds the key after setup.
            EncryptionKeys clientKeys = keys.ForClient(config.encryptionMode);
            IDataStore store = config.CreateStore(null, clientKeys, options => ConfigureStore(options));
            _description = clientKeys.Describe(config.encryptionMode, origin);
            _store = store;
            DataIO.Default = store;
        }
        finally
        {
            Release(config);
        }

        if (Debug.isDebugBuild)
        {
            Debug.Log("[ProjectDataIO] Ready. " + _description);
        }
    }

    private static DataIOConfig LoadConfig()
    {
        DataIOConfig asset = DataIOConfig.Load();
        if (asset)
        {
            return UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(asset);
        }

        DataIOConfig config = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<DataIOConfig>();
        config.format = DataFormat.Encrypted;
        config.fileExtension = DataFormats.DefaultExtension(DataFormat.Encrypted);
        config.encryptionMode = FallbackMode;
        config.keySource = FallbackKeySource;
        config.saveFolder = FallbackSaveFolder;
        return config;
    }

    private static void Release(DataIOConfig config)
    {
        if (Application.isPlaying)
        {
            UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(config);
        }
        else
        {
            UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(config);
        }
    }

    private static InvalidOperationException NotReady()
    {
        return new InvalidOperationException("ProjectDataIO is not ready. It initializes before the first scene loads, "
            + "or after InitializeWithKeys for keys that arrive later; check the Console for a setup error.");
    }
}
